content: 10:1-18 Munon yamangar Pol wonou sarau bumaimbari wonou sarau nonogursi qamarei

Munon qei qob qei yet big ete at qamb igour: “Pol wo ininob igo qob qugiab ende at me ininob qamb igo. In wogub mugenderi iua igo qob qugiab ininob qamb igo.” Ende at qamb igour, ego ye Pol, ete aninob qemerine igar: an Yisas wonou qomon musub qerei imbigar. Wo wonomi bumai wogub qomon mein end munon wuriimbig igoai. End ye qob ger ete aninob qemeribam:
Qen geret ye anit yarab qob qugiab aninob qemerin qamb qoyamet igoarar. Qob qugiab eng qemerin eng munon qei yet munangit qomon toat qib igo qamb misir igub igour eng oramar qemeribam.
Git eng apand, in qib igoun eng munon ai qent e qiroau gas ende gari. Ego in qib wuri yogub qib igour gas ende at me qib igoun.
In mi gagam ba qib igoun, ego mi gagam eng munon igaramun qamb ue. Mi gagam eng Qenu wonou qeretutnob eng in ten qib igoun, munon qarau wurinou youn gagam bapamimb qamb.

In wurinou misir ne qomon bunumban igama Qenu me imbigub qamb ibitiri igour eng, wurinou misir eng in soopur qomurune Qenu imbigar qamb. In munangit misir eng ende bumai qomurune Munon inubersiau tari wonou misir eng toat igoarar qamb.
End in an anoar igoun. An in qob quraun eng an igatarari gab eng munon in qob omboarir igour eng wuri borusioruboun.

Qomon eng an magqurt opur igoarar. Munon ger wonou oau apand end Munon Aib yurau igo gab eng, wonou bo musub misir qerei ete iginer: Munon eng wo Yisas yurau igo eng in gor erogori wonou yurau igorun, ende iginer.
Munon Aib in sarau eng abar qamb inmaribigorei. End in aninou oau apand eng nonogursi qamb igoun. An borusiau ue, an musub igoun. Ye ininou sarau eng ebet qen big qib eng ye end me qinininginei.
Ego an qob eng gab yarimar qamb namanimun me gumotoroum.
Munon qei ete yet qomorubour, ‘Pol wo namanimun mugen gumatar eng wo inamar qugiab ininob qamb igo. A wo ininob igo eng wo boru mein, wonou qob eng mi ue gas ende.’
Ego ye anamar igo qob qamb igoum eng nob mugenderi e igo namanimun qas gumotoroum eng qob wes ger ue, an musub qerei imbig gaiar.

In mai ininou, munon qei unum bereri igour gas ende at qib igoun qiyo, eng ininou maigas me imbig qomurunei. Ne gor ininou qomon eng nob munon qei wurinou qomon eng nob maigas me qereimunei, ue. Wuri wurinou misir igour end wurinomi qerei igour. Ne ger der munon ger wonou qomon eng toat ebet igo. Munon eng ebet igour eng wuri boru tagug aib.
Ego in ininou misirt ar unum me bererimunei. Qenu wonou sarau abar qamb qereimotarer qangang end qas ebet isi yarab anit isiba.
In anit me yarau igo ininou uyes ar wobont me unum bereri igoun. In gigit Munon inubersiau tari wonou qob uber eng qamb igoun.

Ne gor in ar wobont der munon qei sarau ebetemir end in ar me unum bereri igoun. In misir gagam ete igo: aninou oau apand eng mom nonoguret igama ne ininou sarau eng mom anit aibt isa ne end mom dibeneriba.
End ne in qob uber bisub qomorun eng ginam qei an mogirt igo end isub qomoruboun. Munon ginam qei munon ger wonou sarau qoan ebeter end isub in ar qen inimbagaiar qamb eng me ubunei.
End Qenu qob ete igo, ‘munon ger wonou qen big eng Munon aib yoopuri ten igo ende qamb Munon aib unum ba ererieminer.’
In mom qoyam eng, munon ger wonou qen big qiriner eng Qenu menmant wo unum ue. A Qenu wonou munon ger unum bereriminer eng wo apand unum diban igo.
